caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular banner with a border of red, white, and blue lines. The main background consists of vertical red and white stripes. In the center, there is a large blue-bordered oval surrounded by white stars on a blue background. Inside the oval is a black-and-white illustration of a man in a blue and red military uniform, identified above as "WASHINGTON," standing with his right hand on his hip and his left hand holding a piece of paper. The man stands in front of a light-colored horse, which faces to the left. Above the man’s head inside the oval is a depiction of the Liberty Bell. At the top and bottom of the banner, intersecting the oval border, are two shield designs colored like the American flag with blue, white stars at the top and red and white vertical stripes below, each labeled "SHIELD OF U.S. AMERICA." The overall composition uses primarily red, white, blue, and black.
title: Printed Textile - Historical
